# Launch by Patrick

> Sovereign web and software architecture company based in Lagos
> and Ibadan, Nigeria, with operations in London and remote globally.

Launch by Patrick engineers production-ready, cross-platform digital
systems for founders and companies building unconventional products.
We specialize in Flutter, React, Python, and distributed backend
architecture. We are a company, not a freelancer — built to deliver
world-class engineering from West Africa.

## Mission

We exist for the founder who sees what doesn't exist yet — and
refuses to wait for someone else to build it. Every system we ship
is proof that world-class software engineering lives here, on this
continent, and always did.

## Direction

We are building toward a world where the most ambitious software on
the continent is also built here — by teams who understand what
Africa needs to own, not just consume. Launch by Patrick exists at
the beginning of that story.

## Values

01 — Integrity above delivery: We would rather lose a deadline than
ship a lie. Code that works but misleads is not code we sign our
name to.

02 — Compassion as architecture: We build for the person whose
livelihood depends on this system working. That human weight lives
in every technical decision.

03 — Unconventional by design: The conventional solution already
exists. If we are rebuilding what is already there, we are wasting
the continent's time.

04 — Sovereignty over convenience: We don't build dependence on
foreign rails when we can engineer the rail itself. Every shortcut
that creates lock-in is a tax on Africa's future.

## What We Build

- Super app ecosystems and embedded fintech platforms
  (inspired by WeChat, Alipay, KakaoTalk, Grab, Mercado Libre)
- Hyper-local marketplaces and distributed commerce systems
  (inspired by Uber, Craigslist, Shopify, Walmart, Temu)
- Content-to-commerce and creator economy platforms
  (inspired by YouTube, TikTok, Audiomack, Patreon, Substack)
- High-retention gamification and digital vault systems
  (inspired by Duolingo, Steam, Epic Games, Roblox, Microsoft)

## Services

- High-velocity architecture and MVP scoping: We streamline complex
  system requirements to their highest-leverage product cores,
  deploying production-ready infrastructure to market in weeks.

- Infrastructure audits and system remediation: Deep-dive reviews
  of high-entropy or AI-generated codebases to isolate bottlenecks,
  plug memory leaks, and optimize network throughput.

- Strategic architectural leadership: Technical sovereignty for
  founders and executive teams on multi-tenant ecosystem scaling,
  stack selection, and decoupled modular migration paths.

## Technology Stack

Flutter, Dart, React, Tailwind CSS, Python, Node.js, PostgreSQL,
GIS (Uber H3), Android Studio, C/C++, Java

## Founding Group

Launch by Patrick also founded EchoLevel Sentinel LTD, an IoT fuel
telemetry company providing real-time asset monitoring for standby
generators and logistics fleets across Nigeria. This is a separate
company and brand built on top of Launch by Patrick's infrastructure.
